Information about the team:
We are looking for an experienced BCO and IT Risk Management Team Lead to join our team and take ownership of developing and implementing our Non Financial risk management strategy. You will lead an existing team of experts - including Business Control Officers, Key Control Testers (SOX/ICS), and Security/IT Risk Officers - and drive its further development, collaborate with key stakeholders, and ensure compliance with regulations and best practices in IT risk management.
The role naming convention in the global ING job architecture will be "Lead Business Control II”.
